dedupeText: country grit album aesthetic cowboy muddy pickup truck electric guitar distressed border western rugged outdoor portrait subject in white contrast against dark brown mud diagonal line created by the guitar neck leading to the subject s face red truck acting as a mid ground anchor between the subject and the green forest background textured border containing the central photographic action combine a high contrast subject white clothing in a dirty environment mud dust with a heavy textured frame and eroded slab serif typography to create a classic rugged country aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A rugged outdoor scene featuring a man in western attire sitting in deep mud with an electric guitar, positioned in front of a mud-splattered red pickup truck. The entire composition is framed by a heavy, distressed 'grunge' border that mimics peeling paint or dried mud.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in white contrast against dark brown mud
Diagonal line created by the guitar neck leading to the subject's face
Red truck acting as a mid-ground anchor between the subject and the green forest background
Textured border containing the central photographic action
coreInvariants: Mud splatters on the subject's white clothing
A white cowboy hat as a high-value focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated in the lower left quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately 40% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white cowboy hat and the red body of the pickup truck.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright white hat, follow the guitar neck down to the right, then circle back through the mud to the truck and background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant featuring the sky and trees provides breathing room for secondary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (brown mud, green trees) providing a grounded base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (hat and shirt) against dark mud.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red (truck and guitar body) providing warmth and visual interest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white clothing and the dark earth; muted saturation in the background to keep focus on the foreground.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to organic, outdoor tones

letterConstructionRules: Heavy distressing and erosion applied to all glyphs
Irregular edges mimicking stamped or stenciled ink
Variable opacity within letterforms to suggest wear
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters for the secondary title to create a casual, grounded feel
All-caps for the primary name to establish authority
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a white, wide slab serif with a dark, condensed sans-serif, both unified by heavy distressing.
graphicDevices: Simulated mud splatters overlapping the frame

preserve: Slab serif for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a white cowboy hat and white button-down shirt sits in a deep, dark mud pit holding a red electric guitar. Behind him is a red pickup truck covered in mud. The background is a dense green forest under a pale blue sky. Apply a thick, irregular, distressed brown border around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, white, distressed slab-serif font in the top left. Directly below it, add the title in a medium-sized, dark brown, condensed, heavily eroded sans-serif font using all lowercase letters.

verificationChecks: Is the border sufficiently distressed and irregular?
Are there mud splatters on the white shirt?
Is the guitar neck creating a clear diagonal line?
Does the text look weathered rather than clean?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact guitar headstock shape and branding

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between name and title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white hat is the brightest point in the image.
Check that the text is legible despite the heavy distressing.
Verify the mud texture looks wet and heavy, not like flat paint.
Confirm the border does not obscure the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast subject (white clothing) in a dirty environment (mud/dust) with a heavy, textured frame and eroded slab-serif typography to create a classic rugged-country aesthetic.
